title: Fred (Fritz) Ogden's later career and death
summary: Fred Ogden was known as Fritz, became an investment businessman, and took his own life while suffering from cancer.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: Yeah, Fred Ogden is Fritz. He committed suicide a few years ago, remember? No. Yeah, he lived right around the corner from where I was living at that time on, what the hell street was it? Thad and Chestnut, I believe. He walked right down there, half a block down, right the same street where he lived and shot himself right out on the street. That was Fritz, or Fred as we called him. Fred got to be quite a big shot, not a big shot, but I mean he had a very profitable investment business. That was his business. He was mixed up with one of these outfit stock and bond deals. That was his. And I think the thing that made him commit suicide was not any financial trouble, but he had a kind of cancer situation.
